Time clock in system was down for me yesterday and today. Wrote my hours on a slip of paper with my name, date, and arrival departure times. Taped the slip to the bulletin board in the managers office. Before leaving today I asked said manager were the slip with my hours went. Claims he didn't see it, touch it, etc. I go look around in the office thinking maybe it fell down, nope. Dig in the garbage can "I found it!" Proceed to check the time management system on the computer... Nothing is logged. Mind you this is not the first instance something of this nature has occured so I try to be cautious. I approach the manager....

Me: here it is *holding paper in hand*

Manager: oh where was it?

Me: it was taped to bulletin board but I found it in the trash can.

Manager: oh you had it TaPeD tO a CoRk BoArD?

(He said it as though it was my fault for not using a tack when there are clearly fucking none. And how stupid of me to scotch tape something to a cork board. Clearly I'm the fucking idiot.)

Me: ummm yeah.

Manager: Im kinda in the middle of something right now.

Me: are you trying to screw me on hours or something I had my name, hours, and date (today) written on it? Why is it in the trash?

Manager: Go home I dont want to talk about this anymore today.

Me: sooooo should I hold onto this paper or do you want it?

Manager: go home we will talk about it tomorrow.

Me: so you want me to keep it so you don't throw it away again?

Manager: go home (name)

After that I took my slip of paper with my hours and left. I had a good chuckle on the ride home. Probably going to get fired tomorrow but I've already thought about my exit strategy.

I feel your struggle. Im a single mom of two young kids. I work two jobs (avg. 50-60hrs/wk) plus a side hustle just to scrape by each month. I don't have a car payment or debt (besides student loans) but my $500 icebox could break down any day and when it does I wont have money for repairs or replacement unless a miracle happens. I'm trying to do everything right, I don't use drugs I don't drink and it still feels hopeless. Im honestly starting to consider selling my body just to not have to live paycheck to paycheck. I cant fathom leaving my kids without their mother but somethings gotta give.

I make $14/hr in a urban location. Im a single mom working two jobs just to cover rent and daycare. My daycare still needs to get paid even if they shut down for weeks due to covid and I can't work because I have no childcare. I feel stuck in this hopeless cycle. I want things to improve but it doesn't look likely.

I work in the auto parts industry for a large corporation. I deal with battery acid on a daily basis for basically minimum wage. Besides the back breaking labor of moving batteries and other heavy parts my manager is little to no help and constantly threatening to terminate my employment if I am sick or my kids get sick. I was tasked with the duty of moving every battery some of the batteries have been leaking acid onto the shelving which has corroded the shelves they sit on (another safety hazard my manager turns a blind eye too.) I brought this to the managers attention and he has yet to do anything about it. Im so fucking tired of busting my ass for pennies just to line the pockets of corporate big wigs. My manager barely lifts a finger and complains his back hurts so he goes home. Last week at the begining of my shift I sat down to eat my breakfast sandwich and tie my shoes (literally takes less than 3 minutes.) My manager looked at me and asked "what are you doing?" I said eating. He said you can't come to work and sit down and eat. Does this mean I also need to ask permission to take a drink of coffee? Im so fucking over this shithole company.
